import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(r"C:\Users\acer\OneDrive\Desktop\ConstraintFlip")
validation_dir = root / "validation"
wrong_cpp = validation_dir / "wrong_output.cpp"
wrong_cpp.write_text("#include <bits/stdc++.h>\nusing namespace std;\nint main() {\n    cout << 0 << \'\\n\';\n    return 0;\n}\n", encoding="utf-8")
wrong_exe = validation_dir / "wrong_output.exe"
cp = subprocess.run(["g++", "-std=c++17", "-O2", str(wrong_cpp), "-o", str(wrong_exe)], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert cp.returncode == 0, cp.stderr
out = subprocess.run([str(wrong_exe)], input="4 10\n1 2 3 4\n", capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
assert out.stdout.strip() != "1"
bad_cpp = validation_dir / "bad_compile.cpp"
bad_cpp.write_text("int main() { return ; }\n", encoding="utf-8")
cp2 = subprocess.run(["g++", "-std=c++17", "-O2", str(bad_cpp), "-o", str(validation_dir / "bad_compile.exe")], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert cp2.returncode != 0
rt_cpp = validation_dir / "runtime_error.cpp"
rt_cpp.write_text("#include <iostream>\nint main() {\n    int x = 0;\n    std::cout << 1 / x << std::endl;\n    return 0;\n}\n", encoding="utf-8")
rt_exe = validation_dir / "runtime_error.exe"
cp3 = subprocess.run(["g++", "-std=c++17", "-O2", str(rt_cpp), "-o", str(rt_exe)], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert cp3.returncode == 0, cp3.stderr
rt = subprocess.run([str(rt_exe)], input="", capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
assert rt.returncode != 0
timeout_cpp = validation_dir / "timeout.cpp"
timeout_cpp.write_text("#include <iostream>\nint main() {\n    while (true) {}\n    return 0;\n}\n", encoding="utf-8")
texe = validation_dir / "timeout.exe"
cp4 = subprocess.run(["g++", "-std=c++17", "-O2", str(timeout_cpp), "-o", str(texe)], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert cp4.returncode == 0, cp4.stderr
try:
    subprocess.run([str(texe)], input="", capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=1.0, check=False)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("timeout did not trigger")
